summary: Badge's doc said 'do not attach onClick' while its props extended HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, which permits onClick, onKeyDown and tabIndex — the doc and the types disagreed, and the types are what callers actually obey. Same class of defect as the phantom render slot found on Button. onClick/onDoubleClick/onMouseDown/onMouseUp/onKeyDown/onKeyUp/tabIndex are now Omitted from BadgeProps, so faking interactivity on a span is a compile error rather than a review comment. `role` is deliberately kept: role="status" on a live badge is legitimate. Two @ts-expect-error assertions added. Also added computed-style tests for the trailing-icon size, since the arbitrary variant [&_svg]:size-* compiles to a descendant rule and a class existing proves nothing about which element it reaches.

migration.manual: Re-add @bydiorama/badge. Any call site passing onClick to a Badge must move the handler into an iconEnd button or wrap the badge in a real control.
